dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress web site as a raster image.
In the Robert Knox Sneden Scrapbook, 1870-1899 (p. 192).
Includes portions of Orange, Culpeper, Fauquier, Prince William, and Fairfax counties, Va.
NOTE: Researchers will be served a color photocopy of this scrapbook image.
Original scrapbook housed in the Museum Department of the Virginia Historical Society (1994.80.4-525) with restricted access.
Robert Knox Sneden diary (Mss5:1 Sn237:1), Virginia Historical Society.
Shows the line of march of the Confederate Army and of the Union Army of Virginia as commanded by John Pope during the 2nd Bull Run Campaign, June-September 1862.
This item is from the collections of the Virginia Historical Society; please contact the institution for more information.
dct_title_s: Map of Popes [sic] campaign in northern Virginia, August 1862.
